## Key Engineering & Design Specializations
- **AOSP & Android Kernel Engineering**: Custom Android kernel compilation (Clang/LLVM), Energy Aware Scheduling (EAS), CPU governor tuning, ZRAM/ZSTD memory optimization, thermal mitigation, and production ROM builds for Qualcomm Snapdragon and Google Tensor chipsets.
- **Cinematic UI/UX & Web Development**: High-performance full-stack web applications using Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and GSAP micro-animations with Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **Native Mobile Development**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material Design 3, SQLite Room database architecture, offline-first Android applications.
- **AI & Agentic Systems**: Multi-agent AI architecture with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM tool calling, RAG pipelines, structured output validation with Zod.
- **Design Systems**: Typography engineering (Inter, Space Grotesk), dark-mode design tokens, Figma-to-code handoff, component library architecture.

## Services (Ninety5 Studio)
- Performance & Architecture Audit (3–5 days)
- Custom AOSP & Kernel Engineering (2–4 week sprints)
- Full-Stack Product & UI/UX Craft (4–8 weeks end-to-end)

## Selected Works & Projects
- **Titan**: High-performance PWA with Next.js and atomic IndexedDB state management (https://github.com/rayyan-x95/Titan)
- **EduCard**: Smart educational ID and attendance tracking system with encrypted credentials (https://github.com/rayyan-x95/EduCard)
- **Habitate**: Offline-first Android habit tracker with Jetpack Compose and Room DB (https://github.com/rayyan-x95/Habitate)
- **AI Career Navigator**: LLM-powered career roadmap and resume optimization pipeline
- **F1 Telemetry Dashboard**: Real-time Formula 1 data visualization platform with D3.js
- **LUT WebGL Playground**: WebGL color grading lookup table tool for in-browser use
